title: Phase 1.5 — Everyday VM developer CLI and profiles
objective: After Phase 1 is accepted and merged, provide a simple everyday developer CLI over the existing trusted VM lifecycle core; keep this roadmap separate from M2 acceptance and do not implement during M2.

acceptance_criteria.text: Provide ./lab vm up /path/to/workspace, ./lab vm up --profile profile-1 --dir /path/to/workspace, and explicit ./lab vm up --unsafe-recurse forms, plus straightforward status, ssh, tui, stop, and profile-selection commands.
Support a default profile and optional named profiles with safe validated workspace assignment and persistent defaults; each profile has independent persistent VM, disk, and session identities.
Define the exact semantics and safety consequences of --unsafe-recurse before implementing it; make recursion an explicit, auditable opt-in.
Keep the trusted lifecycle, ownership, provenance, and rollback guarantees behind the simpler interface; do not create a second or weaker VM-management implementation.
Deliver as Phase 1.5 after Phase 1; do not expand M2 acceptance or implement this roadmap during M2 except for a minimal compatibility decision needed to avoid throwaway interfaces.
